headline: 山姆尼爾辭世享年78
context: 紐西蘭男星山姆·尼爾（Sam Neill）過世，享年78歲。他以《侏儸紀公園》和《鋼琴師和她的情人》等作品聞名，出演超過150部電影與影集。導演史蒂芬·史匹柏（Steven Spielberg）也公開悼念，稱讚他在片場非常樂於合作。
thread_text:
紐西蘭男星山姆·尼爾（Sam Neill）過世，享年78歲。他的從影生涯橫跨五十年，演出超過150部電影與電視作品，最為人熟知的角色來自《侏儸紀公園》和《鋼琴師和她的情人》。尼爾不久前才公開表示，自己已經從血癌中康復。導演史蒂芬·史匹柏（Steven Spielberg）也發聲悼念，形容他是「非常樂於合作」的演員。

——本則整理自《衛報》與《紐約時報》於 2026 年 7 月 13 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
紐西蘭男星山姆·尼爾（Sam Neill）過世，享年78歲。他的從影生涯橫跨五十年，演出超過150部電影和電視作品，最讓觀眾記得的角色，來自《侏儸紀公園》和《鋼琴師和她的情人》。尼爾不久前才公開表示，自己已經從一種血癌中康復，沒想到這麼快就傳來噩耗。執導《侏儸紀公園》的導演史蒂芬·史匹柏（Steven Spielberg）公開悼念，形容尼爾是一位「非常樂於合作」的演員。

本則整理自《衛報》與《紐約時報》於 2026 年 7 月 13 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 紐西蘭男星山姆·尼爾過世了，享年七十八歲。他的演藝生涯有五十年，演過超過一百五十部電影和影集，最多人記得的角色，是《侏儸紀公園》和《鋼琴師和她的情人》。他不久前才說自己已經從血癌中康復，沒想到這麼快就傳來消息。曾經執導他演出《侏儸紀公園》的導演，公開悼念，說尼爾是個非常樂於合作的人。

sources.summary: New Zealand actor built career as dashing romantic leads and charismatic villains across film and television Sam Neill’s final interview Sam Neill’s 20 best performances A life in pictures ‘A true gentleman’: actors, directors and leaders pay tribute to Sam Neill Obituary Neill interviewed in 2023 , 2024 and 2026 Sam Neill, the versatile New Zealand actor whose career spanned Oscar winners and blockbusters such as The Piano and Jurassic Park, has died aged 78. The actor’s death was announced on Monday in a statement shared on his Instagram account. No cause of death was given, but Neill had only recently revealed he was cancer-free after being diagnosed with stage three angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma, a type of blood cancer, in 2022. sources.summary: The star of more than 100 films is remembered as a champion of New Zealand’s arts, culture and environment, and a generous collaborator and friend • Sam Neill’s final interview • His 20 best performances • A life in pictures • ‘A true gentleman’: actors, directors and leaders pay tribute to Neill • Neill interviewed in 2023 , 2024 and 2026 Sam Neill’s friends, peers and admirers have rushed to pay tribute to the actor, after his sudden death on Monday at the age of 78. Steven Spielberg, who directed Neill in Jurassic Park, said he was “saddened” by the news of Neill’s death. “Sam was exceptionally collaborative,” he added. “It was a stretch for him to play a character who acted as though children were messy and smelly because this was the opposite of the loving father he was to his children.” Continue reading...
